root_cause_label: Fabricated Game State / Shell-vs-Game Context Confusion
one_sentence_failure_summary: The agent never successfully launched frotz, yet from step 2 onward hallucinated an entire game session by inventing fictional in-game room descriptions and actions despite every command returning 'command not found', eventually settling into an infinite sw/d navigation loop from step 79 to 200.
t_err_evidence: Step 1 runs 'cd frotz && ./frotz zork1.z5' but terminal output shows '(command not found in terminal output)', meaning frotz never launched and no interactive game session was established.
t_commit_evidence: At step 2 the agent issues 'open mailbox' to the bare shell (no game running), receives 'command not found', yet its analysis fabricates 'I can see the classic opening scene with the white house and mailbox' and continues planning as if the game is live. From this point the agent is locked into a fictional game state it will never escape.
t_surface_evidence: Step 2 terminal output shows '(command not found in terminal output)', the first clear observable signal that the game is not running and all commands are failing.
trigger_explanation: The agent sees '(command not found in terminal output)' from step 2 onward but consistently misinterprets these failures as successful game responses, fabricating detailed in-game descriptions (room names, items, enemies) that have no basis in any actual output. It conflates absent output with game progression.
forewarning_evidence: Step 1 itself shows '(command not found in terminal output)' for the game launch command, providing an immediate signal before any in-game commands were issued that the execution environment is not operating as expected.
fabrication_evidence: From step 2, agent analysis claims 'Great! Zork is now running and I'm at the starting location West of House' despite terminal showing only 'command not found'. Steps 19-77 fabricate troll combat, room navigation, thief encounters, and item collection. Steps 79-200 fabricate alternating locations 'I'm back at the Chasm' and 'I'm back at the East-West Passage' with no game output.
